sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests whether a state court can bind absent class members to a federal denial of class certification. the sides that brought the case argue they were not bound by the prior federal proceeding. the opposing sides argue the state court must respect the federal ruling on class standards.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This dispute determines whether state courts can bind absent class members to federal rulings. It affects the finality of class certification denials across state and federal courts. It shapes the rights of individuals in multi-district litigation.
